hero.subtitle: Java · Spring Boot · Microservices · REST APIs
hero.description: Specializing in Java and Spring Boot backend development, microservices and REST APIs. At NTT DATA, I also build interfaces with Thymeleaf and JavaScript. Full stack experience with Angular, Ionic and Laravel.

profile.title: About me
profile.headline: From physiotherapy to backend development.
profile.description: My career began in physiotherapy. I learned to listen, analyze each case and check whether a solution works. That approach stays with me when I develop software.
profile.today: Today I specialize in Java backend development at NTT DATA. My frontend and mobile experience helps me understand how data, business logic and the user's experience fit together.
profile.beyondWork: I also build personal projects, such as Semana Santa La Isla, and share what I learn on YouTube.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.label: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: Specializing in Java and Spring Boot backend development, with experience in microservices, REST APIs and full stack development.

responsibilities: Backend development and maintenance with Java 17 and Spring Boot in a microservices architecture.
Interfaces with Thymeleaf and JavaScript, integrated with business logic in enterprise applications.
Work with microservices deployed on Docker and Kubernetes, using Maven for builds and dependency management.
SQL query development and optimization, and data persistence with MySQL.
Development and maintenance of REST APIs with Laravel and PHP, backend features and SQL queries.
Interfaces and cross-platform applications with Angular, TypeScript and Ionic, connected to backend services over HTTP.
Contributions to mobile apps with React Native and backend integration.
Android features with Java and contributions across different development phases.

projects.holyWeekAppDescription: React Native and Expo frontend for the Holy Week app in San Fernando (Cádiz). Browse brotherhoods, schedules, routes and processional floats, filter by day and follow the system appearance.
projects.holyWeekAppDecision: Persistent caching with MMKV and a bundled fallback catalogue keep brotherhood information available offline, refreshing data from the REST API when available.

projects.project5Decision: In-memory caching with Caffeine and HTTP ETag validation to reduce repeated queries and transfers.
